step1.title: Drop PDFs on the table
step1.subtitle: Surgical slimming that never rasterizes a page. Vectors and text stay exactly as they are, and the result is never larger than the original.
step1.drop_hint: or drop files here — folders are scanned recursively

step2.empty_body: Add PDFs or a folder to start. Everything is processed on this machine.
step2.permissions_tip: Printing/copying restrictions only — removed automatically, no password needed
step2.row_tip: Select to inspect this file's breakdown

mode.title: Compression mode
mode.lossless_desc: Pixels stay bit-identical. Only mathematically reversible transforms run: deflate/Zopfli recompression, lossless JPEG header stripping, grey compaction, palettes, opaque mask removal, deduplication and font subsetting.
mode.balanced_desc: The default. Big photos and screenshots shrink toward 150 DPI and Q85, while flat UI graphics are palette-quantized instead of blurred. Vectors and text are untouched.
mode.max_desc: The smallest honest file: 110 DPI, Q75, more deflate passes and metadata stripped. Still no page rasterization — vectors and text remain untouched.
mode.custom_desc: Your own knob values. Output destination and suffix are preserved while you tune the engine.
mode.tip_lossless: Bit-identical pixels: no resampling, no lossy re-encoding.
mode.tip_balanced: 150 DPI target, Q85 progressive JPEG, palette for flat graphics.
mode.tip_max: 110 DPI, Q75, 25 deflate passes, metadata stripped.

advanced.dpi_hint: Images denser than {trigger} DPI are resampled with Lanczos.
advanced.zopfli_hint: Higher is denser and slower; the cheaper of Zopfli and zlib is always kept.
advanced.sign_label: Sign the output with my certificate
advanced.password_hint: Tried once per run. Never stored or reported.
advanced.warning_invalidate: Removing a signature keeps its visible stamp but permanently invalidates the cryptographic signature. Re-signing uses your certificate and changes the file after compression.
advanced.signing_note: Existing signatures are removed first, then the output is signed.

output.label: Save output to
output.suffix_body: A copy sits beside each original. Originals are never touched.
output.folder_body: Mirror the source subfolders into one destination tree.
output.overwrite_body: Replace each original only after its slimmed output is complete and verified.
output.note: Writes go to a temporary file in the destination folder and are moved into place atomically.

step3.band_notes: Vectors and text preserved · originals untouched
step3.band_notes_signed: Signed with your certificate · vectors and text preserved
step3.band_notes_failed: {count} failed and are not counted in these totals
step3.breakdown_note: Select a completed file to see its own breakdown.
step3.already_optimal: Already optimal — the original bytes were kept.

inspector.subtitle_compare: Original on the left, slimmed on the right — same page, same zoom.
inspector.subtitle_preview: This file has not been slimmed yet, so there is nothing to compare.
inspector.pan_hint: Drag to pan · wheel to zoom
inspector.identical: Byte-identical to the original: nothing could be removed.

picker.hint_files: Single click selects a file; Ctrl/⌘-click adds more. Double click a folder to open it.
picker.hint_folder: Open a folder, then choose “Use this folder”.
picker.hint_output: Every slimmed file mirrors its source subfolder inside this folder.
picker.hint_cert: A PKCS#12 keystore (.p12 or .pfx) containing your signing key.

confirm.overwrite_body: This will replace {count} original file(s) after each slimmed copy is written and verified. It cannot be undone.
confirm.flatten_body: The visible signature stamp is kept, but the cryptographic signature stops validating. Continue only if you own these documents.
confirm.quit_body: Files are still being processed. Quit now?
confirm.quit_detail: The file currently being compressed will finish first, and finished outputs are kept. No partial PDF is ever written.
confirm.sign_title: Sign the output with my certificate
confirm.sign_body: The existing signature locks are removed first, then the slimmed file is signed with the certificate you choose. Only documents you own should be re-signed. The certificate password is used for this run only.

password.title: Password required
password.body: {name} is protected by an open password. Enter it once and the failed files are retried.
password.label: Document password
password.hint: Used for this run only; never written to settings or the report.
password.permissions_hint: Permission-only restrictions (printing, copying, editing) need no password and are removed automatically. This prompt appears only when a document's content is encrypted under an open password.

help.title: About OzemPDF
help.about_body: OzemPDF rewrites embedded images, font programs, deflate streams, metadata and cross-reference structures — never page content. Vectors and text are untouched by construction, and an output is never larger than its input.

notices.upload_staged: {name} was copied into the app's staging folder, because a browser cannot expose its real location. Output goes beside that copy.
notices.upload_failed: Could not receive the dropped file
notices.drop_unsupported: Drop PDFs or folders from the file browser, or use “Add PDFs”.
notices.optimal: Already as small as it gets — the original was kept.

errors.input_missing: The input file does not exist
errors.output_unwritable: Cannot write to the output folder: {reason}
errors.password_required: This file's content is encrypted under an open password; it cannot be decrypted without that password
errors.protection_unsupported: This file uses certificate (public-key) or unsupported encryption; its private key is required and this engine cannot decrypt it
errors.read_failed: This file could not be read as a PDF
errors.permission_denied: Permission denied for {path}. Close any application that has the file open; if it is in OneDrive or another cloud folder, open it once in Explorer so it is downloaded locally.
errors.nothing_to_slim: There are no pending files to slim
errors.render_failed: This page could not be rendered
errors.upload_failed: The upload could not be saved

cli.description: Surgical lossless and visually-lossless PDF slimming. With no inputs, the desktop app opens.
cli.epilog: Exit codes: 0 all files succeeded, 1 no PDFs found, 2 at least one file failed.
cli.help_help: show this help message and exit
cli.help_inputs: PDF files and/or folders (folders are scanned recursively)
cli.help_gui: open the desktop app, optionally pre-loaded with the given paths
cli.help_serve: run the local app server without compressing anything
cli.help_port: port for the local app server (0 chooses a free port)
cli.help_no_browser: do not open a browser window when starting the app
cli.help_max_dpi: downsampling target in DPI, 72–600 (disables strict lossless)
cli.help_strip_meta: strip XMP metadata and document info
cli.help_flatten: remove signature locks and flatten signatures (invalidates them)
cli.help_output_dir: write into this folder, mirroring source subfolders
cli.help_json_report: write a JSON report to this path, or - for stdout
cli.help_sign_p12: PKCS#12 certificate used to sign the output
cli.help_sign_reason: reason shown inside the new signature
cli.help_lang: interface language code (for example en, de, pt_BR)
cli.no_pdfs: No PDF files were found in the given paths.
cli.report_failed: Could not write the JSON report: {error}
cli.already_optimal: {count} file(s) were already optimal; the original bytes were kept.
cli.signed: {count} output(s) were signed with the supplied certificate.
cli.unlocked: {count} permission-restricted document(s) were unlocked without a password.
cli.unlocked_one: 1 permission-restricted document was unlocked without a password.
